hotel.description: modern three storey business hotel used by a football team, glass and pale concrete, large TEAM HOTEL sign over a canopy entrance with revolving door, flagpoles with national flags, potted trees, seen from the front and above

charity.description: small British charity shop on a high street, faded green shopfront with a big sign board above the window, window display of second hand clothes, hats and mannequins, a rack of coats outside, red brick upper floor, flat roof, seen from the front and above

surplus.description: small army and navy surplus store, khaki green shopfront with a sign board above, window display of camouflage jackets, balaclavas, boots and flares, crates outside, red brick, flat roof, seen from the front and above

bookies.description: British betting shop bookmakers, bright purple and gold shopfront with a big sign board above, frosted windows with football odds posters, red brick, flat roof, seen from the front and above

ticketoffice.description: small football stadium ticket office booth, two serving windows with grilles, TICKETS sign board on top, queue barriers in front, steel and blue paint

merch.description: match day merchandise stall with a striped red and white awning, England scarves, flags, shirts and joke masks hanging up, folding table

cabin.description: grey portakabin site office for stadium stewards, small windows, steel door with steps, STEWARDS sign, hi-vis jackets on hooks outside

turnstiles.description: football stadium turnstile entrance block, three turnstile doorways with green lit signs above, concrete and steel facade with a big TURNSTILES sign, club crest, seen from the front

facade.description: long section of a football stadium outer wall, grey steel cladding panels above red brick, a row of club banners, emergency exit door, seen from the front, wide

floodlight.description: tall football stadium floodlight pylon, steel lattice tower with a big bank of lamps at the top

burgervan.description: white burger van food truck with a serving hatch open, BURGERS sign, gas bottles, menu board

barrier.description: metal crowd control barrier, police style, grey steel

lamppost.description: tall street lamp post, black metal

programmes.description: match programme seller stand, small kiosk with stacks of programmes and a sign

bigscreen.description: big outdoor fan zone screen on a steel frame showing a football match, speakers either side

policevan.description: British police riot van, white with blue and yellow battenberg markings, seen from the side and above

lorry.description: beer delivery lorry seen from directly above, cab at the right end, flatbed with stacked beer kegs and crates, orange cab roof

coach.description: white luxury team coach bus seen from directly above, long white roof with air conditioning units and roof hatches, front windscreen at the right end

staffdoor.description: stadium staff entrance, grey steel door in a brick wall with a STAFF ONLY sign above, a security camera, a card reader
